# `vox-oauth-pkce`

**Crate:** `vox-oauth-pkce` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

RFC 8252 loopback-server OAuth PKCE flow, used for in-app free-tier key provisioning.

## Crate Overview

Minimal RFC 8252 (OAuth for Native Apps) loopback-server PKCE flow,
provider-agnostic core + an OpenRouter-specific driver.
